description: Mutants for the core logic: each one breaks the code on purpose and the unit tests must fail. Not listed because equivalent: the session's own refusal of an empty search (QueryHistory.record refuses it too). Also not listed because equivalent: the controller keeping a filter that is not an identifier (effectiveFilter treats it as everything anyway). Not listed because equivalent for the calculator: a text with a single piece (the 'no work' rule refuses it already), a conversion with no unit on the left (the unit lookup refuses it), a very long unit name (it is not found anyway), a zero that keeps its sign (JavaScript writes -0 as 0), and a decimal mark other than a comma (it is shown as a point). Not provable here: that the System window closes BEFORE an action runs (it matters for the shell's confirmation dialogs, which a headless test shell cannot show). Also equivalent for the type filter: a very long name after '/' (no type has one), and the controller's own refusal of a type with no word (the files source finds nothing without a word anyway).
